summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Corgi U.S. Micro-Cap 2x Daily ETF (XIWC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in micro cap equity. The fund  uses swap agreements and other financial instruments to pursue 2x leveraged exposure to the daily performance of the iShares Micro-Cap  ETF (IWC), before fees and expenses. The fund does not aim to achieve 2x of the underlying ETF for any period other than a single day. XIWC was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.
